questions.stem: He ____ (write) a letter to his friend now.

options.distractor: write 以不发音的 e 结尾，要先去 e
be 动词后要接 -ing 形式

questions.explanation: write 去 e 加 -ing：is writing。

questions.stem: Look! The dog ____ (run) after a cat.

options.distractor: 重读闭音节要双写 n
Look! 说明正在追，要用进行时

questions.explanation: run 双写 n 加 -ing：is running。

questions.stem: She ____ (sit) by the window and reading a book.

options.distractor: sit 是重读闭音节，要双写 t
后面的 reading 提示这里也是进行时
缺少 be 动词，且拼写错了

questions.explanation: sit 双写 t 加 -ing：is sitting（与 reading 并列）。

questions.stem: The students ____ (have) a maths lesson at the moment.

options.distractor: at the moment 说明此刻正在进行
the students 是复数，且缺 be 动词

questions.explanation: have 表示“上课、进行某项活动”时可以用进行时：are having。

questions.stem: 下面哪个单词拼写是错误的？
questions.explanation: swim 是重读闭音节，正确拼写是 swimming（双写 m）。

questions.stem: He ____ (lie) in bed and reading a story book now.

options.distractor: ie 结尾要变 y 再加 ing
后面的 reading 和 now 提示用进行时

questions.explanation: lie 以 ie 结尾，变 y 加 -ing：is lying（不要写成 lieing）。
